business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (continental European tradition with constitutional and administrative law elements)

Colombia – European Union Free Trade Agreement
Colombia – Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Colombia, Mexico, Peru, Chile)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Law 1621 of 2013 (financial information and intelligence rules); Law 1762 of 2015 (anti-foreign bribery); Decree 2100 of 2023 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUBF, administered by DIAN); External Circular 011 of 2021 issued by UIAF and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SARLAFT requirements); Decree 2555 of 2010 (financial sector framework).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certificate of identity and legal capacity of each settlor, beneficiary, trustee, and individual beneficial owner, including certified Spanish translation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of origin, with authorized translator if translation is required
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if country of origin is party to the Apostille Convention) OR Consular Legalization through a Colombian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the irrevocable offshore trust instrument or deed of establishment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Court, notary, or competent trust registry in the trust's governing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or due registration of the offshore trustee entity and any intermediary corporate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent regulator of the offshore jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney in favor of the Colombian counsel or incorporation agent for pre-incorporation filing purposes
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or Consulate in the country of authorization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional and banking reference letters for each UBO and relevant beneficiary, indicating source of funds and expected transactional profile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Compliance officer or correspondent bank of the reference institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Apostille/Consular Legalization where applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, settlors, beneficiaries, trustees, authorized signatories, and each identifiable UBO against the US OFAC SDN List, United Nations Consolidated List, European Union consolidated sanctions list, United Kingdom sanctions list, and Colombia's domestic terrorism financing and money-laundering watchlists. PEP identification and enhanced diligence are mandatory for current and former senior public officials, their family members and close associates as defined under Colombian law and UIAF SARLAFT rules. Independent external database checks and a documented risk-rating model (SARLAFT) must be implemented; any match or anomaly triggers a report to UIAF and, where applicable, the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUEE) through the competent Cámara de Comercio and the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be expressed in Spanish script and must comply with Colombian naming conventions under Article 87 of Law 222 of 1995 and the Commercial Registry rules. The legal ending 'S.A.S.' must appear in uppercase. Names must not be identical, similar, or confusingly aligned with an existing registered name. Non-Spanish personal or geographic names must be transliterated phonetically into Spanish using the Latin alphabet, preserving the distinctive expression. Commas, punctuation marks, prohibited symbols, and names that convey a deceptive public authority must be avoided. Words indicating financial, insurance, trust, fiduciary, or regulated activities are subject to prior authorization from the corresponding supervisory entity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An administrative appeal (recurso de reposición) may be submitted in writing to the competent Cámara de Comercio within five (5) business days following rejection. The appellant must indicate the proposed name, the registry search report, the reason for disagreement, and any supporting documents. If the registry holds that the name is confusing or unauthorized, the applicant may submit a new name request directly through the VUEE system. Reserved names cannot be extended beyond 30 days; a new reservation may be requested if the original reservation expires without registration.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For an ordinary S.A.S., the registered office may be a physical address in Colombian territory where the legal representative, management, and corporate records are available. However, for a licensed fiduciary and trust administration business classified under ISIC 6430 and requiring AML/CFT supervision, a pure virtual office, shared workspace, or post-office box is not acceptable as the sole registered office. A physical location within Colombia must be identified and maintained, with adequate facilities for retaining books and records, receiving official notifications, and allowing inspection by the Superintendencia de Sociedades, UIAF, DIAN, or the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk, quantified at approximately 75–90% probability of an unannounced physical inspection during the first 12 to 24 months of operation due to the special statutory license requirement, the high-risk AML/CFT classification, and the presence of offshore irrevocable trust structures. Inspections will almost certainly occur if any screening alert, PEP exposure, transactional anomaly, or negative media report arises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada – S.A.S.); Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), articles 98–130, 205–325; trust operations also governed by Decreto 2555 de 2010, Part 2, Title 2 (sociedades fiduciarias) and Superintendencia Financiera regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the statutory domicile; coordinated with DIAN for tax registration and Superintendencia de Sociedades for corporate oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos Sociales (simplified S.A.S. format) submitted through the Registro Único Empresarial – RUES; public deed (Escritura Pública) required if real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital under Ley 1258 de 2008; share subscriptions may be deferred according to the bylaws. However, a fiduciary trust administration license requires a minimum net worth, paid-in capital, and guarantee policy in UVT units demanded by the Superintendencia Financiera; funds must be placed in a separate escrow bank account during the authorization review.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION, S.A.S. BE IT RESOLVED by the shareholders representing one hundred percent of the subscribed capital: 1. Ratify the issuance and full payment of the subscribed shares as reflected in the constitutional deed. 2. Adopt as registered office the premises in Bogotá, Colombia, designated for legal notifications, service of process, and tax domicile. 3. Appoint as Corporate Administration: [Legal Representative], [President], and [Secretary] with individual faculties. 4. Authorize the Legal Representative to obtain the NIT and RUT, to open fiduciary trust accounts, and to apply for the special financial infrastructure license before the Financial Superintendence. 5. Order registration of the minutes and bylaws with the Chamber of Commerce. So resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá or competent local Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online application via the Chamber's virtual platform or at the Registro Mercantil window. Propose up to five distinct corporate names indicating the legal form 'S.A.S.' Pay the nominal search fee and obtain the certification confirming availability or rejection on grounds of similarity or identity.
required_dossiers: Completed homónimo application form
Identification document of the requesting shareholder or attorney-in-fact
Proof of payment of the search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, submit a new application with alternate names or request a reasoned opinion from the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio to settle the conflict.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Legalization of the Constitutional Deed and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (when notarization is required) and/or Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the simplified private constitutional document in accordance with Ley 1258 de 2008, including company name, domicile, purpose, capital structure, term, administration, and shareholder clauses. If any contribution consists of real property, sign the document before a notary as an escritura pública. Authenticate all shareholders' signatures and have the initial accounting and assets certified by a public accountant before delivery to the registry.
required_dossiers: Constitutional deed or private document (original and copies)
Valid identification of each shareholder
Power of attorney and attorney-in-fact ID if applicable
Certificado de tradición y libertad if real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry identifies omissions or discrepancies, prepare a supplementary act (aclaración o reforma) to correct the defect and resubmit; notarial rejections may require restated pages or a new signature date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration with the Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the chosen corporate domicile
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed constitution document together with the completed Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) and the DIAN information annex. Pay the matriculation and registration fees. The Registry will examine the legal sufficiency of the deed, assign the Mercantile Registration number, and issue the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal after approval.
required_dossiers: Original and copy of the constitutional deed
RUES form duly signed by the legal representative
Applicant identification (cédula/passport)
Proof of payment of registration and matriculation fees
Statement of acceptance of legal representative if not included in the deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a formal query due to defects (e.g., incorrect capital terms or incomplete purpose), file a corrective act and resubmit. The legal effect of registration is reinstated once the error is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification (NIT) and RUT Registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the registration certificate and corporate data, access the DIAN virtual office, complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application, select the applicable tax responsibilities (income tax, VAT if relevant, and withholding), and receive the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Thereafter activate electronic invoicing requirements and mandatory electronic signature procedures.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal from Cámara de Comercio
Constitutional deed
Identification of the legal representative
Completed RUT form (pre-registration)
Proof of the tax domicile address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any inconsistency in the RUT may be corrected via the DIAN 'actualización del RUT' service; if a technical rejection arises, resubmit after verifying the registered information with the Cámara de Comercio.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Adoption, Officer Registration, and Book Legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio and the company's governing bodies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first shareholders' meeting and adopt the First Board Resolution and corporate governance manual. Record the resolution in the Libro de Actas. Register the appointment of legal representative, president, and secretary with the Cámara de Comercio, and have the official books (minute book and share registry) ruled and stamped or electronically registered.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution minutes (original and copy)
Identification of appointed officers
Formal acceptance forms signed by each officer
Registration form for official books
Corporate governance manual (optional but recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber of Commerce refuses officer registration due to statutory disqualification, call an extraordinary meeting to replace the officer and file a substituted resolution; for book irregularities, correct pagination and re-submit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC), in coordination with the Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de Funcionamiento para Sociedad Fiduciaria

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or the competent municipal environmental authority (Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category III (administrative office activity, no industrial emissions). A full EIA is not required for trust administration; however, any construction of a physical vault or heavy reinforcement triggers municipal environmental permits under Decreto 2820 de 2010 and local land-use ordinances.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for fiduciary office operations. Minimal compliance: municipal wastewater and solid waste collection standards, noise limits for HVAC and generators, and proper disposal of electronic waste under the Colombian WEEE framework.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Certificado de Bomberos), structural inspection for vault or heavy equipment installation, occupational risk clearance from the ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales), and a workplace emergency evacuation plan approved by the local civil defense authority.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado de Bomberos), structural load inspection for any secure vault or heavy fixtures, and workplace safety and health clearance from the Compañía de Seguros de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) including an emergency response plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - official national tax and customs administration; principal portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-services via the 'Sede Electrónica DIAN' platform (successor to Muisca), including RUT, e-invoicing validation gateways, and taxpayer document services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate the S.A.S. through the 'Cámara de Comercio' of the registered office, filing the private incorporation document and registering in the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES); the Chamber assigns a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) upon issuance of the Chamber certificate. (2) Within 30 calendar days after the incorporation date, formalize the definitive tax registration with DIAN by submitting the 'Registro Único Tributario (RUT)' application, either through the integrated single-window procedure (VUE) or directly via the DIAN portal; the RUT must reflect the company as an IVA responsible in the 'régimen común' and include responsibility code R.99 if export zero-rating of trust-administration services will be claimed. (3) Obtain and register the legal representative's digital signature certificate (certificado de firma electrónica) issued by a DIAN-accredited certification authority to enable electronic invoicing and RUT updates. (4) File the regulatory authorization of the 'sociedad fiduciaria' license granted by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (Decreto 663/1993, Article 29) and update the RUT with the special activity code ISIC 6430 (trust administration) and the high-risk AML supervisory designation. (5) Open a corporate bank account and register the foreign-exchange intermediation data with the local financial entity to receive and formally settle the offshore fee remittances in compliance with Banco de la República Circular DCIN-83; the applicable foreign-exchange declaration ('Declaración de Cambio', forms 5 or 6) is required for each remittance received from the foreign trustee.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - the Colombian S.A.S. is by law a resident capital company subject to national corporate income tax at 35% (for tax year 2024) on worldwide income; there is no pass-through or transparent regime for S.A.S. companies. The irrevocable offshore spendthrift trust administered by the S.A.S. is a separate non-resident structure and is not a Colombian taxpayer; the S.A.S. pays tax on its fiduciary fee income, while Colombian-resident beneficiaries of the offshore trust become taxable on distributions only when such distributions are actually received, subject to the anti-deferral and controlled-foreign-corporation provisions of the Estatuto Tributario.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide a check-the-box or free entity-classification election. The relevant statutory elections available to a licensed fiduciary S.A.S. are: (i) the voluntary update of the RUT to include IVA responsibility 99 ('exportadora') enabling the zero-rating of export-fiduciary services; (ii) the optional exclusion from municipal ICA (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio) territorial taxation where the service is exclusively exported, available under some local ordinances, but not applicable at the national level; (iii) the 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' is statutorily prohibited for entities subject to supervision by the Superintendencia Financiera, therefore unavailable to this S.A.S.; (iv) group income-tax consolidation under Article 124-4 of the E.T. (introduced by Law 2277/2022) for Colombian financial groups with direct or indirect ownership of 90% or more, subject to prior DIAN authorization; (v) the formal election to present annual transfer-pricing documentation and, where applicable, advance pricing agreements with DIAN; (vi) hybrid-mismatch rules under Law 1819/2016 and Law 2277/2022 are mandatory, with no affirmative election permitted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de-minimis turnover threshold for legal entities: a commercial S.A.S. must be registered in the RUT as an IVA responsible taxpayer from the date of incorporation regardless of actual revenue. The simplified IVA regime ('régimen simplificado') is reserved to natural persons whose gross sales, consignations, and income do not exceed 3,500 UVT (COP 164,727,500 for 2024, with the UVT set at COP 47,065 for tax year 2024); that regime is never available to a corporate fiduciary. Registration is therefore compulsory ab initio, with no local-currency threshold applicable to the S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory DIAN-approved electronic invoicing applies to all taxpayers since 2023. The S.A.S. must issue the 'Factura Electrónica de Venta' (FEV) exclusively through a certified technology provider ('Proveedor Tecnológico'/'Operador Tecnológico') or through DIAN's free e-invoicing platform. Each invoice is transmitted in real time to the DIAN fiscal backend via the REST/JSON-XML API under the 'validación previa' modality, meaning DIAN must validate and authorize the electronic document before the invoice is delivered to the foreign trustee. Every FEV must contain the unique 'CUFE' code for sales invoices or 'CUDS' for purchase-support documents, a QR matrix, the issuer's digital certificate, year/date/operation type, and the R.99 export indicator for zero-rated service fees. The S.A.S. must transmit and receive the DIAN acceptance receipt by 11:59 pm of the same business day of issuance, retain the XML authorization receipt, and file the aggregate monthly IVA declaration (Form 300) and the annual 'Información Exógena' report, including the e-invoice listing, through the DIAN portal. Purchase-side substantiation requires the 'Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones' (DSA) for any domestic expense that does not carry an FEV.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% IVA) applies under Article 481(e) of the Estatuto Tributario and Decree 1418/2016, as amended by Decree 1550/2021, to services rendered to a foreign recipient that (i) has no permanent establishment in Colombia, and (ii) receives the full economic benefit and use of the service outside Colombian territory. For the fiduciary administration of an irrevocable offshore spendthrift trust, the S.A.S. must demonstrate: the trust is governed by foreign law; the settlor, protector, and all discretionary beneficiaries are non-resident and non-domiciled abroad; the S.A.S. holds no Colombian situs for the trust assets and maintains no day-to-day management office in Colombia that decides discretionary distributions; the asset-protection instructions (including the selection of offshore financial institutions, custodians, and investment accounts) are executed from the foreign jurisdiction; and the management fee is invoiced to and paid by the foreign trustee from funds outside Colombia. Prior to invoicing, the S.A.S. must obtain the 'Certificado de Exportación de Servicios' from DIAN through Form 12565 or Form 13106, enter the service in the DIAN exporter registration ('Registro de Exportadores de Servicios'), and maintain the certificate current; absence of the certificate causes the automatic application of 19% VAT to the fees.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX), and for services, the DIAN-issued 'Certificado de Exportación de Servicios' (Form 12565/13106) together with the updated service export registration in the DIAN system;

Bill of Lading or Air Waybill for any physical trust asset movements, or, for pure fiduciary services, the offshore custody-bank asset statement and the contractual shipment/transfer records evidencing movement of trust assets;

Inward Remittance Certificate - 'Certificado de Cambio' / 'Declaración de Cambio' issued by a Banco de la República authorized intermediary proving receipt of hard currency from the foreign trustee within the foreign-exchange settlement term;

Supporting legal and transactional file: the irrevocable spendthrift trust deed, KYC/AML files of settlor and beneficiaries, board resolutions of the S.A.S., the fiduciary management and investment reports, and the trust's banking and custody records evidencing exclusive economic use of the services abroad;
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may review export zero-rating claims within the general 3-year assessment period (5 years where tax returns were not filed or where deficiencies are linked to unregistered transactions). If the supporting documentation is incomplete, unsatisfactory, or the service is recharacterized as performed in Colombia, the S.A.S. loses the 0% rate and DIAN retroactively assesses the 19% IVA, plus monthly default interest (the rate published monthly by DIAN, approximately 1.25% per month for 2024). The taxpayer is also subject to the 'sanción por inexactitud' under Article 648 E.T., as amended by Law 2277/2022, equal to 100% of the omitted VAT; where the export certificate was obtained fraudulently, the penalty may be calculated on the total invoice value and the exporter is removed from the exporters register. Failure to repatriate the foreign currency within 180 days constitutes a foreign-exchange infringement under Banco de la República Circular DCIN-83, triggering administrative surcharges, loss of the REF and zero-rating certificate, and disqualification from future export programs. In cases of intentional evasion, criminal sanctions apply under Law 1762/2015 (Article 434-A of the Criminal Code): imprisonment of 48 to 108 months and fines of up to 200% of the tax evaded; additionally, where the offshore trust administration is used for money-laundering purposes, the S.A.S. may be organized and closed by the Superintendencia Financiera in coordination with DIAN and the UIAF, and the responsible officers may face forfeiture and asset-freezing measures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (the Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for bank licensing, solvency and AML/CFT supervision, and with the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for exchange-control enforcement; the operative legal basis is Law 9 of 1991, Decree 2555 of 2010 and the Banco de la República Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83 (Régimen de Cambios Internacionales).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a free-market floating exchange system (COP) with selective exchange controls. Current-account transactions (fiduciary service fees, dividends, royalties and interest) are freely convertible through authorized exchange intermediaries without prior central-bank approval, but must be channeled through the Mercado Cambiario. Capital-account flows (inbound trust corpus, equity injection, external credit) are unrestricted, yet registration with the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales is mandatory before any profit repatriation, capital liquidation or external-debt amortization; unregistered investments forfeit repatriation rights. Dividend remittances are lawful once the underlying investment is duly registered, provided taxes are settled and the Declaración de Cambio is filed with the intermediary. No material operational hurdle exists for profit remittance by a licensed fiduciary, although source-of-funds documentation and underlying trust transaction evidence will be scrutinized by the beneficiary bank and the SFC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Service exporters (including a fiduciary earning management fees from offshore trusts) must channel export proceeds through the Colombian exchange market within 6 months from service accrual or invoice date; goods exporters have 6 months from the export declaration, extendable once by up to 6 additional months. Channeling is required for each operation exceeding USD 10,000: 100% of the receivable FOB or service value must be liquidated into the Mercado Cambiario by sale to, or deposit with, an authorized intermediary (commercial bank or foreign-exchange brokerage). Amounts up to USD 10,000 per operation are exempt from the channeling obligation. Receipts collected outside the statutory timeline constitute an exchange violation under Banco de la República rules, triggering fines and loss of the right to reintegrate capital; all supporting documents (service export declarations, invoices, SWIFT MT103 receipts) must be retained for five years.

Operational Cuenta Corriente and Fiduciary Clearing Account
Dual-currency USD/COP Corporate Treasury and Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW for primary treasury custody; MEDIUM as an ancillary payment gateway. Colombian law (Law 1735 of 2014, Decree 2555 of 2010) reserves deposit-taking and payment-account services to SFC-supervised credit establishments and licensed SEDPEs. An offshore digital EMI (Wise, Mercury, Revolut, etc.) cannot lawfully hold the entity's client trust funds, act as the settlement bank, or serve as the clearing hub because it is not an authorized Colombian exchange intermediary, cannot receive regulated fiduciary deposits, and would circumvent the mandatory exchange-channeling rules. Offshore EMIs may support non-client disbursement flows only (e.g., market-data subscriptions, software-as-a-service) with express prior consent of the onboarding bank, provided no trust corpus and no foreign-exchange reintegro is executed through them; any such use must be disclosed in the SAGRILAFT/AML file and reconciled monthly.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical onboarding. Pursuant to SFC Circular Básica Jurídica Part I, Title IV and the SAGRILAFT regime, a high-risk special-license entity (trust/fiduciary) must present its legal representative, holding valid Colombian ID or passport, and at least one additional director or ultimate beneficial owner for an in-person KYC interview at the bank's principal Colombian office. The interview verifies identity, source of wealth, intended transaction pattern and authenticity of business purpose; original corporate documents — current certificado de existencia y representación legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio within 30 days, notarized bylaws, board resolutions, and the SFC fiduciary license — must be reviewed. 100% remote opening is unavailable as a first step; only ancillary foreign directors may sign via apostilled, notarized power of attorney, with video attestation accepted at the discretion of the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque discretionary trust structure: ultimate beneficial ownership is legally dispersed among the settlor, protector, trustees and discretionary beneficiaries, which conflicts with Colombia's mandatory UBO identification rules.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full certified trust deed and deed of amendment; apostilled identity documents (passport or national ID) for the settlor, trustee, protector and named beneficiary classes; comprehensive UBO declaration (Formato de Beneficiarios Reales under SAGRILAFT); organizational charts of intermediate entities; written asset-protection purpose statement; SFC fiduciary license; client-asset segregation register evidencing blindaje patrimonial under Decree 2555.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk offshore jurisdiction footprint and negative-media/sanctions screening hits involving settlement jurisdictions used by the offshore trusts (US states, Cayman BWI, Channel Islands).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three years of audited financial statements of the trust and corporate settlors; independent accountant source-of-wealth letters; bank reference letters from the settlor's existing banks; legal opinions on trust validity, economic purpose and tax compliance in each jurisdiction; dated negative-news and sanctions screening reports from World-Check, Dow Jones or LexisNexis; signed fiduciary services agreements evidencing arm's-length fee compensation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction flow: large inbound trust corpus received in Colombia followed by accelerated onward distribution to foreign beneficiaries with no demonstrable commercial trade.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank-approved cash-flow model (flujograma) listing expected frequency, volumes, beneficiaries and purpose codes for every treasury movement; trust deed and investment policy confirming lawful distribution authority; client onboarding files with beneficiary identity verification; monthly reconciliation reports to the SFC; Declaraciones de Cambio preserving purpose-code narratives; anti-fraud and transaction-monitoring framework adopted by the compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory capacity: the S.A.S. is acting as a fiduciary without an SFC special license as a Sociedad Fiduciaria, which is a stand-alone AML trigger and may disqualify the entity from general banking services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the SFC authorization certificate (estatuto de sociedad fiduciaria) or, pending issuance, the formal application file and SFC acknowledgment; evidence of minimum paid-in capital of approximately COP 5.2 billion; certified SAGRILAFT compliance program with appointed oficial de cumplimiento; professional indemnity/fidelity insurance policy; board minutes confirming segregation of client trust assets from corporate assets per Decree 2555; monthly regulatory returns.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital must arrive via SWIFT MT103 (single remittance) to the entity's COP or USD account at an authorized Colombian exchange intermediary, using the beneficiary name and NIT, the full Colombian account number (no IBAN), and the intermediary's SWIFT/BIC; the narrative must cite the foreign-exchange purpose code: 330 for investment/equity subscription, 444/451 for external or supplier credits, or the trust-corpus purpose code applicable to foreign investment. Within 10 business days of receipt, the bank or brokerage files the Declaración de Cambio (Formulario No. 1), and the investment must be registered in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales on the Banco de la República platform before any future dividend or principal repatriation. The bank's compliance verification includes: investor identity and ultimate ownership, board resolution in Spanish authorizing the contribution, apostilled trust deed or subscription agreement, and source-of-funds certificates. Amounts at or below USD 10,000 may be received freely but remain subject to documentary retention and suspicious-transaction reporting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements exclusively use regulated clearing rails: SWIFT MT103 for beneficial foreign wires (trustee fees, beneficiary distributions, debt-service payments, dividend remittances), each backed by the relevant Declaración de Cambio (Formulario 14 for services, Formulario 10 for returns to foreign investors) and with withholding taxes remitted to DIAN via Formulario 100/110 before transfer. Commercial letters of credit (cartas de crédito) governed by UCP 600 are used for trade-based trust-asset settlements, with Colombian issuing banks confirming documents, fee-invoice evidence and the sanctioned goods/services list; local Colombian disbursements ride the automated clearing house rails (CUD/ACH via SEBRA and CENIT). All wires pass the bank's OFAC/UN/EU/UK sanctions screening; no crypto, cash-courier, pre-paid-card or informal value-transfer rails are permitted under the Colombian exchange regime.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD forward exchange contracts (forwards) with authorized local banks, requiring documented underlying foreign-currency exposure (USD-denominated trust fee receivables).
European-style plain-vanilla COP/USD options (calls and puts) with licensed Colombian or OECD-regulator counterparties, recorded at mark-to-market under IFRS 9 hedging rules.
Cross-currency swaps (permutas financieras de moneda) matching long-term USD trust receivables with COP operating costs, subject to SFC derivative authorization and ISDA/CSA documentation.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only with regulated international counterparties when the hedge tenor exceeds available domestic liquidity or the counterparty is foreign; settlement in USD without COP delivery, requiring full underlying-exposure documentation.

Combination interest-rate/FX swaps and structured collars meeting the entity's board-approved hedging policy, provided valuations are independent and margin/collateral arrangements comply with SFC prudential limits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Commercial Registry (Renovación del Registro Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March; tariff bands applied based on the company's total assets
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal requires re-registration at higher tariff; administrative fine of up to approximately USD 1,200; continuous non-renewal causes suspension of registry effects for new corporate acts and may trigger involuntary dissolution and liquidation proceedings by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta para Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due 8–19 April each year, per the annual DIAN schedule determined by the last digit of the NIT; no general extension available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of the tax due, subject to a minimum of 10 UVT; daily default interest on any unpaid balance; omission triggers DIAN assessment under Article 743 E.T. and, if fraudulent, criminal tax-evasion penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within May–June per the DIAN resolution of that year; the 2025 filing window closes on 23 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to 1% of the higher of net equity or gross revenue, capped at 28,000 UVT (approximately USD 330,000), plus default interest; incomplete or erroneous data also exposes the filer to DIAN automated risk-scoring and audit flags.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Assets Declaration (Declaración Anual de Activos en el Exterior)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June; mandatory for residents holding foreign assets or offshore trust interests above the indexed threshold (approximately COP 7,900–8,400 million, roughly USD 1.9–2.1 million)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of the wealth-tax base plus default interest; omission materially elevates the trust administrator's DIAN risk profile and may be treated as an unjustified asset discrepancy leading to formal assessment and anti-evasion penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Wealth Tax Return (Impuesto al Patrimonio)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually due 16–20 May per DIAN schedule, subject to the statutory regime enacted for tax years 2023–2026
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of the assessed wealth-tax liability, daily default interest, and administrative collection proceedings; continued non-payment can result in embargo of bank and fiduciary accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Shareholders' Meeting, Approval of Financial Statements, and Minute-Book / Register Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (statutory books and annual accounts deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting must be held by 31 March; approved financial statements and minutes must be entered in the statutory books and deposited with the Chamber within one month of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the meeting or to deposit annual accounts bars dividend distributions, subjects directors to fiduciary liability for damages, and constitutes grounds for involuntary dissolution under Articles 457–458 of the Código de Comercio.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Owner (UBO) Annual Confirmation (Información de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (consolidated beneficial-owner module inside the annual income tax return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted as a mandatory annex to the Declaración de Renta; due with the return during the April filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or incorrect reporting of ultimate natural persons is sanctioned under Article 651 E.T. with fines up to 28,000 UVT (approximately USD 330,000); false disclosure may be escalated to tax-fraud prosecution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Fiduciary License Renewal and Supervisory Contribution (Renovación de la autorización fiduciaria y contribución de supervisión)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: License anniversary date for renewal; the annual supervisory contribution is payable in the first quarter according to the SFC contribution resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment of the supervisory contribution blocks the continuation of fiduciary operations; persistent delinquency may result in suspension or revocation of the special trust-administration license, in addition to fines imposed under the SFC sanctioning regime.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory external auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory for: (i) licensed fiduciary entities supervised by the SFC; (ii) companies with total assets or gross income exceeding 5,000 SMLMV (approximately USD 1.75 million); and (iii) issuers of public securities. This licensed discretionary-asset-protection-trust administrator qualifies under the SFC license regime, so an independent certified audit is obligatory every fiscal year.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS as adopted in Colombia (Decreto 2420 de 2015, as amended); fiduciary assets and entrusted trust operations are additionally reported under SFC Circular 100 and the applicable fiduciaria accounting chart.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative confirms the beneficial-ownership tree (direct, indirect, and controlling natural persons) annually within the Declaración de Renta; any shareholding transfer during the year must be reflected in the Shareholders' Register and disclosed in the UBO annex in the immediately following annual return. As a licensed fiduciary, the entity must also present UBO and AML/PTEE certification data within the SFC supervision cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Junta Directiva / Registro de Representantes Legales)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y Junta Directiva)
Fiduciary Trust Ledger (Libro de Negocios Fiduciarios - SFC requirement)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 2,500 per year (registered office and statutory agent in Bogota, Medellin, or Cali)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - USD 18,000 for the certified independent audit of a licensed fiduciary SAS with annual trust assets under USD 25 million

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
